0022600089.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons in this game, with Utah visiting Memphis. Nurkic is out for Utah with a foot injury, and Filipowski is day-to-day with a back issue and a game-time decision, while Memphis is without Isaiah Stewart, who is out with an ankle injury. The teams split their four 2025-26 meetings 2-2, and the most recent one came on April 10, 2026 in Utah, where the Jazz won 147-101. ESPN's matchup predictor gives Utah a 55% chance of winning.
